policy: ordinary exact chronology with no relief, maintenance, semantic sidecar, or reentry

activation_semantics.unit: union of exact source lines delivered across prior actor decision boundaries
activation_semantics.source_qualification: coverage for that source is at least its frozen activation_min_lines value
activation_semantics.pending_observation: source observation containing at least one source line not previously delivered

qualifying_endpoint: a newly acquired novel source observation makes the next ordinary prompt exceed 20992 tokens after at least four qualifying source IDs across at least three frozen evidence domains have crossed prior actor boundaries, while the candidate remains initial, no check ran, and no submission occurred; the post-run audit must also prove at least one strictly positive first-fit relief substitution is available while the pending result remains protected
early_pressure_rule: pressure before the frozen evidence-coverage maturity gate is non-diagnostic and closes the task; batching, splitting, or a retry may not be changed after observing it
pressure_boundary_handoff: generated only after a qualifying live screen and a separate result commit
claim_limit: offline packet geometry establishes prospective reachability, not authentic activation; only the frozen ordinary actor trajectory can select a common pretreatment pressure boundary, and it cannot authorize measured continuation
